newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares post new record despite late slide.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares post new record despite late slide.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Swiss shares posted a record close, but ended below the day's highs as early losses on Wall Street led to profit taking in late trade.
Volume was very high. Dealers said Novartis, subscription rights for Ciba Specialty Chemicals and UBS were in the limelight. Ciba rights were making their bourse debut.
The outlook depended on the trend on Wall Street, which today opened with a slump following U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee.
* Blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) up 35.8 points, or 0.79 percent, to 4,539.7, after touching an all-time high at 4,566.0.
